card.name: Linking words before a named quinolone
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a fluoroquinolone class or drug name, where another quinolone name is about to follow. Seen mostly on "including" after "Fluoroquinolones,".

modes.label: including after the class
modes.description: The word "including" after "Fluoroquinolones," just before a named drug.
modes.example: Psychiatric Adverse Reactions Fluoroquinolones,<< including>> ciprofloxacin, have been

modes.label: and/or between quinolones
modes.description: "and" or "or" joining quinolone names in a list.
modes.example: quinolone antimicrobials such as ciprofloxacin<< and>> enoxacin [see Warnings and

modes.label: comma in a drug list
modes.description: A comma between quinolone names in a list of QT-related drugs.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the start of the next name in the list, though the promoted tokens are not clearly related.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word just before the next quinolone antibiotic is named.
